name: zizmor-slsa-report
description: A before-and-after security report for GitHub Actions, powered by zizmor.

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.dev: npm run build:client && concurrently -k 'esbuild src/client.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=public/app.js --watch' 'tsx watch server.ts'
